Thanks

Here is one.  I use multiple includes and packages, so this is the validation version. I use the same set of text sensors in all devices

[pcremote.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/9033751/pcremote.txt)

It happens with all my esphome devices. Random pick is my doorbell:

```yaml
substitutions:
  devicename: deurbel
  upper_devicename: Deurbel

esphome:
  name: $devicename
  platform: ESP8266
  board: nodemcuv2

wifi:
  manual_ip:
    static_ip: !secret wifi_static_ip_deurbel

# General settings: captive portal, logger, api, ota, time, restart switch, wifi
# General sensors: status, uptime, version, wifi info
packages:
  general_settings: !include general_settings.yaml
  general_sensors: !include general_sensors.yaml

binary_sensor:
  - platform: gpio
    pin: D4
    name: "${upper_devicename}"
    filters:
      - invert:
      - delayed_off: 100ms

#
# general_sensors.yaml (include)
#

binary_sensor:
  - platform: status
    name: ${upper_devicename} Status

sensor:
  - platform: uptime
    name: ${upper_devicename} uptime
    update_interval: 300s
  - platform: wifi_signal
    name: ${upper_devicename} WiFi signaal
    update_interval: 300s

text_sensor:
  - platform: wifi_info
    ip_address:
      name: ${upper_devicename} IP Address
    ssid:
      name: ${upper_devicename} Connected SSID
    bssid:
      name: ${upper_devicename} Connected BSSID
    mac_address:
      name: ${upper_devicename} Mac Address
  - platform: version
    name: ${upper_devicename} Version

#
# general_settings.yaml (include)
#

wifi:
  ssid: !secret wifi_ssid
  password: !secret wifi_password
  # Enable fallback hotspot (captive portal) in case wifi connection fails
  ap:
    ssid: ${upper_devicename} hotspot
    password: !secret wifi_fallback_password
  manual_ip:
    gateway: !secret wifi_gateway
    subnet: !secret wifi_subnet

captive_portal:

# Enable logging
logger:

# Enable Home Assistant API
api:

ota:

time:
  - platform: homeassistant
    id: homeassistant_time
    timezone: Europe/Amsterdam

button:
  - platform: restart
    name: ${upper_devicename} Restart

```
Needless to say; worked on HA 2022.6
